synopsis: Everyone's favorite tale of good versus evil takes on a whole new look in this graphic novel! Join Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Princess Leia, Darth Vader, and the rest of the heroes and villains from a galaxy far, far away in this graphic novel collection that retells the original three "Star Wars" films: "A New Hope," "The Empire Strikes Back," and "Return of the Jedi." You'll experience the saga in a way you never have before!
title: Star Wars Treasury: The Original Trilogy
